Usage: yantra template save [options] <path>

Validate and save a Markdown template in the local library.

Arguments:
  path                  template Markdown path

Options:
  --name <name>         saved name (defaults to frontmatter or filename)
  --tags <a,b>          replace frontmatter tags
  --description <text>  replace the frontmatter description
  --force               overwrite an existing template (default: false)
  --json                emit a stable JSON envelope (default: false)
  -h, --help            display help for command
